implementation_statement: Flaws remediated through the release pipeline within the timeframes in STD-01.5 and FedRAMP VDR rules. Gap: 2 KEVs remediated after the CISA due date (P07; POAM-007).
EDR on management servers and bastions; malware scanning of uploads to the console.

24x7 monitoring of G1 with network, host, and identity detections; the AI triage feature (AI-001) can isolate hosts automatically for some alert classes. Gap: no human review before automated host isolation in G1 (P07; POAM-013). Class D additions not yet in place: SI-4(10) (tLS inspection on corporate egress; management-plane traffic visibility relies on host telemetry only); SI-4(14) (no wireless intrusion detection in G1 data halls to detect rogue devices); SI-4(19) (heightened monitoring of individuals at elevated risk defined for SOC; not coordinated with HR).
Advisories from CISA and vendors received and distributed; FedRAMP Security Inbox monitored (AFC rules).
Security functions verified at startup and daily by automated checks.

Integrity verification of software, firmware, and information with signatures and file integrity monitoring. Class D additions not yet in place: SI-7(2) (integrity violations on hosts alert the SOC; integrity violations in the release pipeline do not); SI-7(5) (no automated response to integrity violations (for example, halting a guest-agent rollout)); SI-7(15) (code authentication enforced for host software and guest agent; not for one BMC firmware model).
Spam protection on corporate email with automatic updates.
API input validation against published schemas.
Error messages reveal no sensitive information to users.
Information retained per the records schedule and agency contracts.
